description: This file contains selector functions for the Right-Hand Sidebar (RHS) in the Mattermost web application, including functions to retrieve selected post details, channel info, search parameters, and UI state flags.

methods.name: getSelectedPostId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the currently selected post in the RHS.

methods.name: getRhsSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the RHS sidebar.

methods.name: getSelectedPostFocussedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when the selected post was focused.

methods.name: getSelectedPostCardId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the selected post card.

methods.name: getHighlightedPostId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the highlighted post.

methods.name: getFilesSearchExtFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the external file search filter.

methods.name: getSelectedPostCard
methods.description: Retrieves the selected post card object.

methods.name: getSelectedChannelId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the selected channel.

methods.name: getSelectedChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the selected channel object.

methods.name: getPluggableId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the current RHS pluggable component.

methods.name: getActiveRhsComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the active RHS component based on the pluggable ID.

methods.name: getRealSelectedPost
methods.description: Retrieves the real selected post object from state.

methods.name: getSelectedPost
methods.description: Selector that returns the selected post or a fake post if deleted.

methods.name: getCurrentSearchForSearchTeam
methods.description: Retrieves current search data scoped to the team or all teams.

methods.name: getRhsState
methods.description: Retrieves the current RHS state.

methods.name: getPreviousRhsState
methods.description: Retrieves the previous RHS state.

methods.name: getSearchTerms
methods.description: Retrieves current search terms.

methods.name: getSearchTeam
methods.description: Retrieves the team ID scoped for search.

methods.name: getSearchType
methods.description: Retrieves the current search type.

methods.name: getSearchResultsTerms
methods.description: Retrieves search results terms.

methods.name: getSearchResultsType
methods.description: Retrieves search results type.

methods.name: getIsSearchingTerm
methods.description: Checks if a search term is being searched.

methods.name: getIsSearchingFlaggedPost
methods.description: Checks if flagged posts are being searched.

methods.name: getIsSearchingPinnedPost
methods.description: Checks if pinned posts are being searched.

methods.name: getIsSearchGettingMore
methods.description: Checks if more search results are being fetched.

methods.name: makeGetChannelDraft
methods.description: Creates a selector to get channel draft data.

methods.name: getPostDraft
methods.description: Retrieves the post draft for a given channel.

methods.name: getIsRhsOpen
methods.description: Checks if RHS sidebar is open.

methods.name: getIsRhsMenuOpen
methods.description: Checks if RHS menu is open.

methods.name: getIsRhsExpanded
methods.description: Checks if RHS sidebar is expanded.

methods.name: getIsEditingMembers
methods.description: Checks if editing channel members in RHS.
